Download EDGAR emissions data

Source: R/source-edgar.R
download_edgar.Rd

Construct EDGAR v8.1 air-pollutant or VOC-speciation archive URLs and download them using the shared validation, preview, and download helpers.

Usage

download_edgar(
  species = c("BC", "CO", "NH3", "NMVOC", "NOx", "OC", "PM10", "PM2.5", "SO2"),
  version = "8.1",
  temp_res = NULL,
  sector_yearly = NULL,
  sector_monthly = NULL,
  sector_voc = NULL,
  format = "nc",
  output = "emi",
  year_range = NULL,
  voc = NULL,
  directory_to_save = NULL,
  acknowledgement = FALSE,
  download = TRUE,
  remove_command = FALSE,
  unzip = TRUE,
  remove_zip = FALSE,
  hash = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  max_tries = 20,
  rate_limit = 2
)

Arguments

species

character vector. Air pollutants to download for version "8.1": "BC", "CO", "NH3", "NMVOC", "NOx", "OC", "PM10", "PM2.5", or "SO2". Defaults to all listed species. Input is case-insensitive; "PM25" is also accepted. Ignored for VOC speciation, which uses voc instead.

version

character(1). "8.1" (default) for air pollutants or "8.1_voc" for VOC speciation.

temp_res

character(1) or NULL. Required for version "8.1": "yearly", "monthly", or "timeseries". Timeseries archives can contain tabular data; see Details for processing limitations. For version "8.1_voc", this does not affect URL selection; if supplied, it is retained in the local archive-name prefix instead of "voc".

sector_yearly

character vector or NULL. Yearly sectors: "AGS", "AWB", "CHE", "ENE", "IND", "MNM", "NMM", "PRU_SOL", "RCO", "REF_TRF", "SWD_INC", "SWD_LDF", "TNR_Aviation_CDS", "TNR_Aviation_CRS", "TNR_Aviation_LTO", "TNR_Aviation_SPS", "TNR_Other", "TNR_Ship", "TRO", "WWT", or "TOTALS". NULL selects totals. Used only for yearly version "8.1" data.

sector_monthly

character vector or NULL. Monthly sectors: "AGRICULTURE", "BUILDINGS", "FUEL_EXPLOITATION", "IND_COMBUSTION", "IND_PROCESSES", "POWER_INDUSTRY", "TRANSPORT", or "WASTE". NULL selects full-species archives. Used only for monthly version "8.1" data.

sector_voc

character vector or NULL. VOC sectors, using the same choices as sector_monthly. NULL selects full VOC-group archives. Used only for version "8.1_voc".

format

character(1). "nc" (default) or "txt". Flux output and monthly version "8.1" data require "nc". Selects an archive template where supported; it does not convert the downloaded files.

output

character(1). "emi" (default) for emissions or "flx" for fluxes. Full-species monthly, timeseries, and full VOC-group archives use fixed provider filenames that do not vary with output or format.

year_range

integer(1 or more) or NULL. One year, two endpoints, or a non-empty vector of years. Every year from the minimum through the maximum is selected, including gaps: c(2018, 2023) and c(2018, 2020, 2023) both select 2018:2023. Years must be non-missing integer values. For yearly version "8.1" data or sector-specific VOC data, NULL (default) selects bundled archives instead of individual yearly archives. Monthly, timeseries, and full VOC-group archives always contain the provider's bundled years; year_range is validated when supplied but does not change their URLs or subset their contents.

voc

integer vector, character vector, or NULL. VOC group numbers from 1 to 25, required for version "8.1_voc". Numeric strings such as "1" are accepted. Ignored for version "8.1".

directory_to_save

character(1). Non-empty parent directory. Archives are saved in zip_files/ and extracted into data_files/.

acknowledgement

logical(1). Must be TRUE to proceed. Archives and extracted data can require substantial storage.

download

logical(1). Deprecated. FALSE warns and returns a preview after directory creation, without making network requests. Default is TRUE.

remove_command

logical(1). Deprecated and ignored; TRUE warns. Default is FALSE.

unzip

logical(1). Extract downloaded or existing archives into data_files/. Default is TRUE. When FALSE, archives remain in zip_files/ without extraction.

remove_zip

logical(1). Remove archives and their parent zip_files/ directory recursively after the extraction loop finishes, including any other files in that directory. Requires unzip = TRUE. Default is FALSE.

hash

logical(1). Return the combined MD5 hash of all files recursively under data_files/, including previously extracted files. With unzip = FALSE, this still hashes data_files/, not the archives. Default is FALSE; ignored when download = FALSE.

show_progress

logical(1). Show per-file download progress. Default is TRUE; summary messages may still be printed when FALSE.

max_tries

integer(1). Maximum attempts per file request, including the initial attempt. Must be at least 1. Default is 20.

rate_limit

numeric(1). Non-negative request-throttling interval in seconds, passed to download_run_method(). Default is 2.

Value

  • With download = FALSE, an invisible list containing urls, destfiles, and n_files, the number of planned archive downloads.

  • With download = TRUE and hash = FALSE, the invisible summary from download_run_method() with success, failed, and skipped counts. It always contains failed_urls and failed_files character vectors, both character(0) when no downloads failed, including when every file was skipped. These counts describe archives, not extracted files.

  • With download = TRUE and hash = TRUE, a visible character(1) combined MD5 hash of all files under data_files/, including existing files.

Details

Scalar selectors version, format, and output use base::match.arg(), allowing unambiguous partial matches. This also applies to temp_res for version "8.1"; for VOC speciation, a supplied temp_res is used as-is in the local archive-name prefix. Sector names require exact, case-sensitive matches. Only the sector argument for the selected version and temporal resolution is used; timeseries downloads use no sector argument.

URL construction retains the v8.1 FT2022 archive templates, including the PM2.5 folder/filename conventions and the SO2 _v2 suffix on full monthly and timeseries archives. Monthly full-species filenames cover 2000–2022; timeseries and full VOC-group filenames cover 1970–2022. Available remote files are not discovered by querying directory listings. Year validation checks the input range, not whether EDGAR provides an archive for each requested year or combination of arguments.

Timeseries archives are not necessarily raster products. For example, the NOx timeseries archive contains an Excel workbook (.xlsx) and a readme, even when format = "nc". process_edgar() currently accepts raster files only, so this workbook cannot be passed through the process_edgar() and calculate_edgar() workflow.

Local archive names retain the edgar_<temp_res>_ prefix, or edgar_voc_ when VOC speciation is requested with temp_res = NULL. Preview results include all constructed URLs and destination paths, including existing files. A preview creates the output directories but makes no network requests and does not verify remote availability. No shell-command file is created.

download_run_method() skips existing non-empty destination files and records individual download failures in its summary. File downloads use the shared default timeout. Extraction and cleanup occur before returning, and extraction errors can prevent a normal return. Summary counts describe downloads, not extraction.

See also

download_data(), download_run_method(), process_edgar()

Author

Mariana Alifa Kassien

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
download_edgar(
  species = "CO",
  temp_res = "yearly",
  sector_yearly = "ENE",
  year_range = c(2021, 2022),
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "edgar"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE,
  download = FALSE
)
download_edgar(
  version = "8.1_voc",
  voc = 1:3,
  sector_voc = "AGRICULTURE",
  year_range = 2021,
  directory_to_save = file.path(tempdir(), "edgar_voc"),
  acknowledgement = TRUE,
  download = FALSE
)
} # }
